previous_statement: Using the bound sum_j a_j^+ h_j <= nu_v from the sign-split step gives s * sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ <= nu_v. Because s > 0 and a_j^+ = max(P_vj,0), division by s yields sum_{j : h(p_j) >= s} max(P_vj,0) <= nu_v / s.
new_statement: Within the notation a_j = P_vj, h_j = h(p_j), a_j^+ = max(a_j,0), and A_s = {j : h_j >= s}, the locally established sign-split estimate sum_j a_j^+ h_j <= nu_v and high-slab estimate s * sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ <= sum_j a_j^+ h_j imply s * sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ <= nu_v. Since s > 0, division by s yields sum_{j : h(p_j) >= s} max(P_vj,0) <= nu_v / s.
